The meat has been cooked in crushed peppers to accent its natural taste|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Pepper Steaks can be made by [[Cooking]] a [[Spicy Pepper]] with any [[Meat]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by adding additional ingredients, such as [[Mushroom]]s or [[Vegetable]]s, that provide effects that contradict the Spicy Peppers. Eating them will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The meat in these dishes is cooked in crushed peppers, which suppresses their gamy taste while highlighting their flavor. Only one variation of Pepper Steak exists: * '''Spicy Pepper Steak''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Pepper Steak}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A dish made by cooking meat in crushed peppers, suppressing the gamy taste while accentuating its flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using the original recipe. When eaten, these steaks will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for Spicy Pepper Steak is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Future of Hyrule]]". It is made using six [[Spicy Pepper]]s and six [[Raw Prime Meat]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to four. [[Cooking]] a Spicy Pepper Steak before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of damage dealt by the [[Warrior]]s by ten percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Spicy Pepper Steak Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Pepper Steak ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Pepper Seafood }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
